editorial:
Imagine your life gets turned upside down when two witches decide to use your family as a playground. You get to follow a family matriarch, a sharp private eye, and a cop who is currently off duty as they try to fight back against some seriously mean magic. It feels like a weird, funny fever dream from the late 80s. The vibe is lighthearted but chaotic, making it the kind of movie you put on when you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some silly fantasy chaos.

What really makes this work is the goofy energy and the way the plot keeps you guessing. The acting is campy in a good way, and the pacing keeps things moving so you never get bored. While the special effects look a bit dated now, that actually adds to the charm. If you love oddball comedies, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the family and their allies finally face off against the witches. Through a mix of wit and a bit of luck, they manage to break the spells and outsmart the villains. The witches are defeated, and the chaos they caused is undone. The family gets their peace back, and the movie ends on a happy note with the bad guys gone for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s camp and weird family comedies.
